[Previous context: Organizational Procedures for Delivery of Entitlements] In addition to procedures associated with the relevant or applicable legislations in Grenada, the

Valuation Division and Inland Revenue Department (IRD) of the MOF conducts property

valuations for taxation and related purposes in Grenada. There is also the newly established

Valuation Appeal Board (launched Thursday December 16th 2010). A number of Appeal

Commissioners, chaired by an attorney at law, will form the Board. Among the list of activities

of the Board will be to hear and adjudicate appeals of any taxpayer who files an appeal with the

Board after assessment of valuation of their property by the Comptroller of Inland Revenue, as

well as arbitrate appeals on Property Transfer Tax.
